profile.example: People today have more leisuretime than ever before.
profile.exampleCn: 如今人们比以往有更多的闲暇时间。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容物品或服务等质量差。
profile.definition: of poor quality; not meeting expected standards
profile.example: The low-quality products were returned to the manufacturer.
profile.exampleCn: 低质量的产品被退回给制造商。
profile.category: IELTS G类 · 复合形容词

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指不因种族、性别、宗教等而区别对待。
profile.definition: not making unfair distinctions based on characteristics such as race, gender, or religion
profile.example: The company has a non-discriminatory hiring policy.
profile.exampleCn: 公司实行非歧视性的招聘政策。
profile.category: IELTS G类 · 复合形容词

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指不符合质量标准的状态或特性。
profile.definition: the state or condition of not meeting quality standards

otherMeanings.definitionEn: not meeting quality standards
otherMeanings.example: The non-quality parts were rejected.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 不合格的零件被拒收。

profile.example: The factory was criticized for the non-quality of its products.
profile.exampleCn: 该工厂因产品质量不合格而受到批评。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指将已冷却的食物或物体再次加热的过程。
profile.definition: the act of heating something again

otherMeanings.definitionEn: relating to reheating
otherMeanings.example: Re-heating instructions are on the package.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 包装上有再加热说明。

profile.example: Re-heating leftovers can kill bacteria if done properly.
profile.exampleCn: 如果操作得当，再加热剩菜可以杀死细菌。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指因电流通过身体而导致的死亡或严重伤害。
profile.definition: injury or death caused by electric shock
profile.example: The worker died from electrocution while repairing the power lines.
profile.exampleCn: 这名工人在修理电线时触电身亡。
profile.category: IELTS G类 · 法律/安全术语

profile.meaningDetailZh: 确保某事发生或得到保证。
profile.definition: To make certain that something will happen or be the case.
profile.example: We must ensure that all safety measures are in place before the experiment begins.
profile.exampleCn: 在实验开始前，我们必须确保所有安全措施到位。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 突出显示或强调某事物的重要性。
profile.definition: To emphasize or make something stand out.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: The most exciting or important part of something.
otherMeanings.example: The highlight of the trip was visiting the ancient temple.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这次旅行最精彩的部分是参观古庙。

profile.example: The report highlights the need for better public transport.
profile.exampleCn: 报告强调了改善公共交通的必要性。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 用于输送液体或气体的柔性管子。
profile.definition: A flexible tube used to convey liquids or gases.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To water or wash something using a hose.
otherMeanings.example: He hosed down the car before polishing it.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他先用软管冲洗汽车，然后抛光。

profile.example: The firefighter connected the hose to the hydrant.
profile.exampleCn: 消防员将软管连接到消防栓上。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 使某人认识另一个人或使某事物被了解。
profile.definition: To make someone known by name to another person, or to bring something into use or notice.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To bring something new into a place or situation.
otherMeanings.example: The company introduced a new policy on remote work.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 公司推行了一项关于远程工作的新政策。

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To present something for discussion or consideration.
otherMeanings.example: She introduced a proposal to reduce plastic waste.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她提出了一项减少塑料垃圾的提案。

profile.example: Let me introduce you to my colleague, Mr. Smith.
profile.exampleCn: 让我把你介绍给我的同事史密斯先生。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 位于头顶上方或上方的。
profile.definition: Located above one's head; in the sky or above.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Above one's head; in the sky.
otherMeanings.example: Birds flew overhead.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 鸟儿在头顶飞过。

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Regular expenses such as rent, utilities, and salaries.
otherMeanings.example: The company's overheads have increased this year.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 公司今年的经常性开支增加了。

profile.example: The overhead lights in the office were too bright.
profile.exampleCn: 办公室头顶的灯太亮了。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 给予某人所需的东西。
profile.definition: To give something needed or wanted to someone.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To stipulate in a document or law.
otherMeanings.example: The contract provides that either party may terminate with notice.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 合同规定任何一方均可提前通知终止合同。

profile.example: The government provides free education for all children.
profile.exampleCn: 政府为所有儿童提供免费教育。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 以重复为特征的，单调的。
profile.definition: Characterized by repetition, especially when tedious or boring.
profile.example: The job involves repetitive tasks such as data entry.
profile.exampleCn: 这项工作涉及数据录入等重复性任务。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 表面光滑，难以抓住或站稳。
profile.definition: Having a smooth surface that is difficult to hold or stand on.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Difficult to deal with or pin down.
otherMeanings.example: The issue of tax evasion is a slippery one.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 逃税问题是一个棘手的问题。

profile.example: The floor was slippery after the rain, so we walked carefully.
profile.exampleCn: 雨后地板很滑，所以我们小心行走。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 将人或货物从一地运到另一地。
profile.definition: To carry or move people or goods from one place to another.
profile.example: Transporting goods by rail is more environmentally friendly than by road.
profile.exampleCn: 通过铁路运输货物比公路运输更环保。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 不适合特定目的或情况。
profile.definition: Not appropriate or fitting for a particular purpose or situation.
profile.example: This area is unsuitable for building due to the risk of flooding.
profile.exampleCn: 由于洪水风险，这个地区不适合建筑。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指背着背包旅行的人，通常预算有限，喜欢经济型住宿和自助游。
profile.definition: A person who travels with a backpack, usually on a budget and staying in inexpensive accommodations.
profile.example: The hostel was full of young backpackers from all over the world.
profile.exampleCn: 这家青年旅舍住满了来自世界各地的年轻背包客。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指参与滑翔伞运动，即利用滑翔伞在空中滑翔。
profile.definition: To take part in the sport of paragliding, flying a lightweight, free-flying glider aircraft.
profile.example: They decided to paraglide off the cliff to experience the thrill of flying.
profile.exampleCn: 他们决定从悬崖上滑翔，体验飞行的刺激。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容物体柔软、不挺括，容易弯曲或下垂。
profile.definition: Tending to hang loosely or bend easily; not stiff or firm.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A flexible magnetic disk used for storing data (short for floppy disk).
otherMeanings.example: In the 1990s, we used floppies to save our documents.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 在90年代，我们用软盘保存文件。

profile.example: The puppy's ears were so floppy that they covered its eyes.
profile.exampleCn: 这只小狗的耳朵太松软了，遮住了它的眼睛。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 审计是指对财务记录或账目进行正式检查，以确保其准确性和合规性。
profile.definition: An official examination of financial records to ensure accuracy and compliance.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To conduct an official examination of financial records; to attend a course without receiving credit.
otherMeanings.example: The company hired an external firm to audit its accounts.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 公司聘请了一家外部事务所来审计其账目。

profile.example: The annual audit revealed several discrepancies in the company's financial statements.
profile.exampleCn: 年度审计揭示了公司财务报表中的几处差异。

profile.meaningDetailZh: drapes 是 drape 的复数形式，指挂在窗户上的厚窗帘，通常用于装饰或遮光。
profile.definition: Heavy curtains hung over windows, often for decoration or to block light.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To arrange cloth or clothing loosely on something.
otherMeanings.example: She draped the scarf over the back of the chair.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她把围巾披在椅背上。

profile.example: The living room was decorated with elegant velvet drapes.
profile.exampleCn: 客厅用优雅的天鹅绒窗帘装饰。

profile.meaningDetailZh: finalist 指进入比赛或竞赛最后一轮（决赛）的选手或团队。
profile.definition: A person or team that has reached the final stage of a competition.
profile.example: She was one of the finalists in the national spelling bee.
profile.exampleCn: 她是全国拼字比赛的决赛选手之一。

profile.meaningDetailZh: self-drive 用于描述一种租车服务，顾客自己驾驶车辆，而不是由司机驾驶。
profile.definition: Relating to a vehicle rental service where the customer drives the vehicle themselves.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A rental car that the customer drives themselves.
otherMeanings.example: We hired a self-drive for our trip around the island.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 我们租了一辆自驾车环岛旅行。

profile.example: Self-drive car rentals are popular among tourists who want to explore at their own pace.
profile.exampleCn: 自驾租车在希望按自己节奏探索的游客中很受欢迎。

profile.meaningDetailZh: banksman 指在建筑工地或码头等场所，负责指挥车辆或机械移动的人员，通常通过手势或信号进行。
profile.definition: A person who directs the movement of vehicles or machinery, especially on a construction site or dock.
profile.example: The banksman guided the truck safely into the narrow loading bay.
profile.exampleCn: 信号员引导卡车安全进入狭窄的装卸区。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 蓝牙是一种短距离无线通信技术，用于在电子设备之间交换数据，如手机、耳机、电脑等。
profile.definition: A wireless technology standard used for exchanging data over short distances between electronic devices.
profile.example: I connected my phone to the car's audio system via Bluetooth.
profile.exampleCn: 我通过蓝牙将手机连接到汽车的音响系统。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指配备有上下铺床位的房间，通常用于多人住宿，如青年旅舍、夏令营或员工宿舍。
profile.definition: Rooms furnished with bunk beds, typically used for accommodating multiple people, as in hostels, camps, or staff quarters.
profile.example: The hostel offers clean bunkrooms with lockers for backpackers.
profile.exampleCn: 这家旅舍为背包客提供配有储物柜的干净宿舍房间。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种便携式动力锯，由导板和链条组成，链条上带有锯齿，用于切割木材、树木等。
profile.definition: A portable mechanical saw with a toothed chain that rotates around a guide bar, used for cutting wood and trees.
profile.example: The workers used chainsaws to clear the fallen trees after the storm.
profile.exampleCn: 工人们用链锯清理暴风雨后倒下的树木。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指从石头或木材上切下或凿下的小碎片，常用于铺路、覆盖地面或作为填充材料。
profile.definition: Small pieces of stone or wood that have been cut or broken off, often used for paving, surfacing, or filling.
profile.example: The garden path was covered with wood chippings to prevent weeds.
profile.exampleCn: 花园小径上覆盖了木屑以防止杂草生长。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种超音速客机，由英国和法国联合研制，于1969年首飞，2003年退役，以高速跨大西洋飞行著称。
profile.definition: A supersonic passenger aircraft jointly developed by Britain and France, first flown in 1969 and retired in 2003, known for high-speed transatlantic flights.
profile.example: The Concorde could fly from London to New York in under three and a half hours.
profile.exampleCn: 协和式飞机可以在三个半小时内从伦敦飞抵纽约。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指从事手工艺制作的人，如木匠、陶工、织工等，强调其技能和传统工艺。
profile.definition: People who practice a craft or trade, such as carpenters, potters, or weavers, emphasizing their skill and traditional techniques.
profile.example: The market featured handmade goods from local craftspeople.
profile.exampleCn: 市场上展示了当地手工艺人制作的手工制品。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指不应该做的事情或规则，通常与“dos”相对，用于指导行为。
profile.definition: Things that should not be done; prohibitions or rules, often contrasted with 'dos'.
profile.example: The handbook lists the dos and don'ts of workplace conduct.
profile.exampleCn: 手册列出了工作场所行为的注意事项和禁忌。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种住宅建筑，分为两个独立的居住单元，通常并排或上下排列，各有独立入口。
profile.definition: A residential building divided into two separate living units, typically side by side or one above the other, each with its own entrance.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Having two parts or functions; double.
otherMeanings.example: The duplex apartment has two floors connected by an internal staircase.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这套复式公寓有两层，由内部楼梯连接。

profile.example: They bought a duplex in the suburbs to have more space for their family.
profile.exampleCn: 他们在郊区买了一栋双拼住宅，以便有更多空间给家人。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指某人或某物被正式免除某项义务、责任或税款等。
profile.definition: Free from an obligation, duty, or payment that others are subject to.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To officially free someone or something from an obligation or payment.
otherMeanings.example: The government exempted small businesses from the new tax.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 政府免除了小企业的新税。

profile.example: Charitable organizations are exempt from paying income tax.
profile.exampleCn: 慈善组织免缴所得税。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 用于比较数量，表示在三个或更多事物中数量最少。
profile.definition: smallest in number; least in quantity.
profile.example: Of all the candidates, she received the fewest votes.
profile.exampleCn: 在所有候选人中，她获得的选票最少。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 非正式用语，表示灵活、可变通的，常用于工作安排等。
profile.definition: Informal term for flexible, especially regarding working hours or arrangements.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A flexible working arrangement, especially flexitime.
otherMeanings.example: I work flexi on Fridays.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 我周五实行弹性工作制。

profile.example: The company offers flexi hours to help employees balance work and life.
profile.exampleCn: 公司提供弹性工作时间，帮助员工平衡工作与生活。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种热带水果，外皮绿色或黄色，果肉粉色或白色，可食用。
profile.definition: A tropical fruit with green or yellow skin and pink or white flesh, edible.
profile.example: Guava is rich in vitamin C and is often eaten fresh or made into juice.
profile.exampleCn: 番石榴富含维生素C，常被新鲜食用或制成汁。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 在英式英语中，指简单、舒适、令人有家的感觉；在美式英语中，指相貌平平的。
profile.definition: In British English, simple and comfortable; in American English, plain or unattractive in appearance.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Plain or unattractive in appearance (American English).
otherMeanings.example: She considered herself homely, but her friends thought she was beautiful.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她认为自己相貌平平，但她的朋友们觉得她很美。

profile.example: The cottage was homely and welcoming, with a warm fireplace.
profile.exampleCn: 这个小屋舒适温馨，有温暖的壁炉。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指某种行为或决定不明智，可能带来风险或不良后果。
profile.definition: Not advisable; unwise or imprudent.
profile.example: It is inadvisable to travel alone in that area at night.
profile.exampleCn: 晚上独自在那个地区旅行是不明智的。

profile.meaningDetailZh: laces 是 lace 的复数形式，通常指鞋带，用于系紧鞋子。
profile.definition: Plural of lace; cords or strings used to fasten shoes.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Delicate fabric made of threads in an open web-like pattern.
otherMeanings.example: The dress was decorated with fine laces.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这条裙子装饰着精美的蕾丝。

profile.example: He stopped to tie his laces before continuing the run.
profile.exampleCn: 他停下来系好鞋带，然后继续跑步。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 主要用于短语 in lieu of，表示“代替”。
profile.definition: Used in the phrase 'in lieu of' meaning instead of.
profile.example: They gave him a cash bonus in lieu of the promised promotion.
profile.exampleCn: 他们给了他现金奖金，而不是承诺的晋升。

profile.meaningDetailZh: marshals是marshal的复数形式，指高级军官、典礼司仪或执法官员。
profile.definition: Plural of marshal; high-ranking officers, ceremony officials, or law enforcement officers.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To arrange or gather together in order.
otherMeanings.example: She marshaled her thoughts before the interview.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 面试前她整理了自己的思绪。

profile.example: The marshals directed the crowd during the parade.
profile.exampleCn: 游行期间，执法官们指挥着人群。

profile.meaningDetailZh: mugs是mug的复数形式，指大杯子，常用于喝热饮；在俚语中也可指脸。
profile.definition: Plural of mug; large cups for hot drinks, or slang for faces.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To attack and rob someone in a public place.
otherMeanings.example: He was mugged on his way home last night.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他昨晚在回家路上被抢劫了。

profile.example: She bought a set of ceramic mugs for the office.
profile.exampleCn: 她为办公室买了一套陶瓷马克杯。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 贝宝是一家提供在线支付服务的公司，用户可以通过电子邮件进行转账。
profile.definition: An online payment service that allows users to transfer money via email.
profile.example: Many online stores accept PayPal as a payment method.
profile.exampleCn: 许多网上商店接受贝宝作为支付方式。

profile.meaningDetailZh: repaid是repay的过去式和过去分词，表示归还借款或回报恩情。
profile.definition: Past tense and past participle of repay; to have paid back money or returned a favor.
profile.example: He repaid the loan in full within two years.
profile.exampleCn: 他在两年内全额偿还了贷款。

profile.meaning: 撕破的；肌肉线条分明的
profile.meaningDetailZh: ripped作为形容词，可表示衣物等被撕破的，也可形容肌肉发达、线条明显。
profile.definition: Torn or split; also used to describe a body with well-defined muscles.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Past tense of rip; to tear something quickly and forcefully.
otherMeanings.example: He ripped the envelope open.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他撕开了信封。

profile.example: He showed off his ripped abs at the beach.
profile.exampleCn: 他在海滩上炫耀他线条分明的腹肌。

profile.meaningDetailZh: roadsmart是一个合成词，通常用于描述与智能交通系统相关的技术或产品。
profile.definition: A compound word used to describe technology or products related to intelligent transportation systems.
profile.example: The city implemented a roadsmart traffic management system to reduce congestion.
profile.exampleCn: 该市实施了智能道路交通管理系统以减少拥堵。

profile.meaningDetailZh: saturdays是副词，表示每个星期六，常用于描述习惯性动作。
profile.definition: On Saturdays; every Saturday.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Plural of Saturday; the days of the week between Friday and Sunday.
otherMeanings.example: We have two Saturdays off this month.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这个月我们有两个星期六休息。

profile.example: I usually go jogging on Saturdays.
profile.exampleCn: 我通常每星期六去慢跑。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指由顾客自己直接进行预订（如酒店、机票等），而不通过中介或代理。
profile.definition: The action of making a reservation (e.g., for a hotel, flight) directly by oneself, without using an intermediary.
profile.example: The hotel encourages self-booking through its website to avoid extra fees.
profile.exampleCn: 这家酒店鼓励通过其网站进行自助预订，以避免额外费用。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指用于悬挂或支撑物体的带子或绳索，常成对使用。
profile.definition: Strips of cloth, rope, or leather used to support or lift something, often in pairs.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To throw something with force.
otherMeanings.example: He slung his bag over his shoulder.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他把包甩到肩上。

profile.example: The workers used slings to lift the heavy machinery.
profile.exampleCn: 工人们用吊索吊起沉重的机器。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指供多人坐的软垫长椅，通常有靠背和扶手。
profile.definition: Long upholstered seats with backs and arms, for two or more people.
profile.example: We bought new sofas for the living room.
profile.exampleCn: 我们为客厅买了新沙发。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指未经请求的、大量发送的电子邮件或消息，通常用于广告或欺诈。
profile.definition: Unwanted, usually commercial, messages sent to a large number of recipients, especially via email.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To send the same message indiscriminately to many people.
otherMeanings.example: He spammed the forum with advertisements.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他在论坛上大量发送广告。

profile.example: My inbox is full of spam from unknown senders.
profile.exampleCn: 我的收件箱里满是来自陌生发件人的垃圾邮件。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容事物具有良好审美，优雅且得体。
profile.definition: Showing good aesthetic judgment or appropriate style.
profile.example: The apartment was decorated in a tasteful manner.
profile.exampleCn: 这套公寓装饰得很有品位。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指喜欢冒险和刺激活动的人，如蹦极、跳伞等。
profile.definition: A person who enjoys exciting and dangerous activities.
profile.example: As a thrill-seeker, she loves bungee jumping.
profile.exampleCn: 作为一个寻求刺激的人，她喜欢蹦极。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种粗纺毛织物，通常有杂色纹理，常用于制作外套和西装。
profile.definition: A rough-surfaced woolen cloth, often with a mixed color, used for jackets and suits.
profile.example: He wore a classic tweed jacket to the countryside gathering.
profile.exampleCn: 他穿着经典的粗花呢夹克去参加乡村聚会。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指文件、画作等没有签名。
profile.definition: Not having a signature.
profile.example: The contract was returned unsigned, causing a delay.
profile.exampleCn: 合同被退回时未签名，导致了延误。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容物品（如衣服、包）的拉链已拉上。
profile.definition: Having a zipper closed.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Past tense of zip; to fasten with a zipper.
otherMeanings.example: She zipped her jacket before going out.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她出门前拉上了夹克的拉链。

profile.example: He handed me a zipped bag containing the documents.
profile.exampleCn: 他递给我一个拉好拉链的包，里面装着文件。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 去除覆盖物或衣物，使裸露。
profile.definition: To remove the covering or clothes from something or someone.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A long narrow piece of material or land.
otherMeanings.example: The runway is a strip of asphalt.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 跑道是一条柏油长条。

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To take away something important from someone, such as a title or property.
otherMeanings.example: The court stripped him of his medal.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 法院剥夺了他的奖牌。

profile.example: The workers stripped the old paint from the wall.
profile.exampleCn: 工人们把旧油漆从墙上剥下来。

profile.meaning: 处理；对付（deal的过去式和过去分词）
profile.meaningDetailZh: 表示过去处理或应对某事。
profile.definition: Past tense and past participle of 'deal', meaning to have handled or managed something.
profile.example: She dealt with the customer's complaint efficiently.
profile.exampleCn: 她高效地处理了客户的投诉。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种电磁辐射，用于医学成像以观察身体内部结构。
profile.definition: A type of electromagnetic radiation used for medical imaging to view the inside of the body.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To examine or photograph using X-rays.
otherMeanings.example: The doctor x-rayed my broken arm.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 医生给我的骨折手臂拍了X光片。

profile.example: The doctor ordered an X-ray to check for fractures.
profile.exampleCn: 医生要求拍X光片检查是否有骨折。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指反对或抵制射频识别（RFID）技术，通常出于隐私或安全考虑。
profile.definition: Opposed to or resisting the use of RFID (radio-frequency identification) technology, often due to privacy or security concerns.
profile.example: The anti-RFID movement argues that tracking chips in consumer goods invade personal privacy.
profile.exampleCn: 反RFID运动认为，消费品中的追踪芯片侵犯个人隐私。

profile.meaning: 科茨洛（澳大利亚珀斯的一个海滨郊区）
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指澳大利亚西澳大利亚州首府珀斯的一个海滨郊区，以其海滩和石灰岩地貌闻名。
profile.definition: A coastal suburb of Perth, Western Australia, known for its beach and limestone cliffs.
profile.example: We spent a relaxing afternoon at Cottesloe Beach, watching the sunset over the Indian Ocean.
profile.exampleCn: 我们在科茨洛海滩度过了一个轻松的下午，看着太阳在印度洋上落下。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 表示在每个星期五发生或进行，常用于描述习惯性动作。
profile.definition: On every Friday; each Friday.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Plural of Friday; the days of the week named Friday.
otherMeanings.example: We have meetings on Fridays.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 我们每周五都有会议。

profile.example: I work from home Fridays to avoid the rush hour commute.
profile.exampleCn: 我每周五在家工作，以避免高峰时段的通勤。

profile.meaning: 周年纪念（尤指二十五周年或五十周年）
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指重要的周年纪念日，特别是君主统治或重大事件的二十五周年（银禧）或五十周年（金禧）。
profile.definition: A special anniversary of an event, especially a 25th or 50th anniversary.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A celebration or festival held to mark such an anniversary.
otherMeanings.example: The village held a jubilee to mark the queen's 60 years on the throne.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 村里举行了庆祝活动，纪念女王登基60周年。

profile.example: The city organized a grand jubilee to celebrate the 50th anniversary of its founding.
profile.exampleCn: 该市组织了盛大的周年庆典，庆祝建市50周年。

profile.meaning: 比利牛斯山脉（欧洲西南部山脉）
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指位于法国和西班牙之间的山脉，是两国的天然边界。
profile.definition: A mountain range in southwestern Europe that forms a natural border between France and Spain.
profile.example: The Pyrenees offer excellent hiking trails and stunning mountain scenery.
profile.exampleCn: 比利牛斯山脉提供了绝佳的徒步路线和壮丽的山景。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指在街头或公共场所为他人搬运货物或行李的人，通常受雇于临时任务。
profile.definition: A person who carries goods or luggage in the street, often hired for temporary tasks.
profile.example: The street-porter helped the tourist carry her heavy suitcases to the hotel.
profile.exampleCn: 街头搬运工帮助游客把沉重的行李箱搬到酒店。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指使某物受到污染或玷污的行为或过程，常指食物、声誉等。
profile.definition: The act or process of contaminating or spoiling something, such as food or reputation.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Present participle of taint; to contaminate or spoil.
otherMeanings.example: The scandal is tainting the company's image.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 丑闻正在玷污公司的形象。

profile.example: The tainting of the water supply caused a major health crisis in the region.
profile.exampleCn: 供水污染在该地区引发了重大健康危机。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指由用户（而非系统或专业人员）创建的内容或产品，常用于互联网和软件领域。
profile.definition: Created by users, as opposed to by a system or professionals; often used in the context of online content.
profile.example: The website relies heavily on user-created content to keep the platform active.
profile.exampleCn: 该网站严重依赖用户创建的内容来保持平台活跃。
profile.category: IELTS G类 · 复合形容词

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种由氯丁橡胶制成的紧身防水服装，用于水上运动以保持体温。
profile.definition: A close-fitting, waterproof garment made of neoprene, worn for water sports to keep the body warm.
profile.example: She put on her wetsuit before diving into the cold ocean.
profile.exampleCn: 她在跳入冰冷的海水之前穿上了潜水服。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指使用木材作为燃料来加热或烹饪的，常用于烤箱或披萨。
profile.definition: Using wood as fuel for heating or cooking, typically referring to ovens or pizza.
profile.example: The restaurant is famous for its wood-fired pizza.
profile.exampleCn: 这家餐厅以其木柴烤披萨而闻名。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指来自其他星球的生命体，或指外国人、外侨。
profile.definition: A creature from outer space, or a foreigner residing in a country.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Belonging to a foreign country or culture; unfamiliar.
otherMeanings.example: The customs of the tribe seemed alien to the visitors.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这个部落的习俗对游客来说显得陌生。

profile.example: The movie is about an alien that lands on Earth.
profile.exampleCn: 这部电影讲述了一个外星人降落地球的故事。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种重型金属装置，用于将船只固定在海底，防止漂移。
profile.definition: A heavy metal device attached to a ship to keep it stationary in the water.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To secure a vessel with an anchor; to fix firmly.
otherMeanings.example: They decided to anchor the boat near the island.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他们决定把船停泊在岛屿附近。

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A person who presents and coordinates a live radio or television program.
otherMeanings.example: The news anchor reported the story calmly.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 新闻主播平静地报道了这则新闻。

profile.example: The ship dropped anchor in the harbor.
profile.exampleCn: 船在港口抛锚。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指海盗，尤指历史上在地中海活动的海盗；也可指海盗船。
profile.definition: a pirate, especially one operating in the Mediterranean; also a pirate ship.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: a privateer, a privately owned armed ship commissioned to attack enemy ships.
otherMeanings.example: The corsair was authorized to seize enemy merchant vessels.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 那艘私掠船被授权夺取敌方商船。

profile.example: The corsair attacked the merchant ship and stole its cargo.
profile.exampleCn: 海盗袭击了商船并抢走了货物。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 通过电子系统发送和接收的消息。
profile.definition: a message distributed by electronic means, typically from one computer user to one or more recipients via a network.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: to send an email to someone.
otherMeanings.example: I will e-mail you the report tomorrow.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 我明天会把报告发电子邮件给你。

profile.example: I received an e-mail from my manager about the meeting schedule.
profile.exampleCn: 我收到了经理关于会议安排的电子邮件。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 以电子形式提供的账单，通常通过电子邮件或在线账户发送。
profile.definition: a bill that is provided in electronic form, typically sent via email or an online account.
profile.example: You can view your ebill online and pay it through the website.
profile.exampleCn: 你可以在线查看电子账单并通过网站支付。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 设计上适合人体自然形态和活动，以提高舒适度和效率。
profile.definition: relating to or designed for efficiency and comfort in the working environment, especially by adapting equipment to the human body.
profile.example: The office provides ergonomic chairs to reduce back pain.
profile.exampleCn: 办公室提供符合人体工学的椅子以减少背部疼痛。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容言辞、论点或行为具有强大的影响力或说服力。
profile.definition: strong and assertive; vigorous or powerful.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: involving physical force or strength.
otherMeanings.example: The forceful push knocked the door open.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 用力一推把门撞开了。

profile.example: She made a forceful argument for reducing carbon emissions.
profile.exampleCn: 她为减少碳排放提出了强有力的论点。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指某个事件或活动之前的准备时期或过程。
profile.definition: The period or process leading up to an event.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Relating to the period before an event.
otherMeanings.example: The lead-up period to the exam was stressful.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 考试前的准备阶段压力很大。

profile.example: In the lead-up to the conference, the team worked overtime.
profile.exampleCn: 在会议召开之前，团队加班加点。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指在同一时间内执行多个任务或活动。
profile.definition: To do several things at the same time.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
otherMeanings.example: She is a multitask worker.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她是一个能同时处理多项任务的员工。

profile.example: In today's fast-paced work environment, employees often need to multitask.
profile.exampleCn: 在当今快节奏的工作环境中，员工经常需要同时处理多项任务。

collocations.chinese: 有效地同时处理多项任务

phraseCollocations.chinese: 在压力下同时处理多项任务

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指邮件、包裹或信息等未被送到收件人手中。
profile.definition: Not delivered; not having reached the intended recipient.
profile.example: The non-delivered parcels were returned to the sender.
profile.exampleCn: 未送达的包裹被退回给了寄件人。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指与教学无关的，尤指学校或教育机构中不直接从事教学工作的职员或活动。
profile.definition: Not involving teaching; relating to staff or activities that are not directly instructional.
profile.example: The school employs both teaching and nonteaching staff.
profile.exampleCn: 学校雇佣教学和非教学人员。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指某事正在进行中，尚未结束。
profile.definition: Continuing; in progress.
profile.example: The on-going construction caused traffic delays.
profile.exampleCn: 持续进行的施工导致了交通延误。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 动词phone的现在分词，表示正在打电话的动作。
profile.definition: Present participle of phone; the act of calling someone by telephone.
profile.example: She is phoning her mother to tell her the good news.
profile.exampleCn: 她正在给妈妈打电话告诉她这个好消息。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 以摄影为职业的人，通常具备专业技能和经验。
profile.definition: A person who earns a living by taking photographs, typically with professional skills.
profile.example: The professional photographer captured stunning images of the wedding.
profile.exampleCn: 专业摄影师拍摄了婚礼的绝美照片。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 用雕刻或塑造的方式制作三维艺术品，也可指塑造身体或形象。
profile.definition: To create a three-dimensional work of art by carving or modeling; to shape or form.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To shape or contour something, especially the body, through exercise or diet.
otherMeanings.example: She sculpts her body with daily workouts.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她通过日常锻炼塑造身材。

profile.example: The artist sculpted a beautiful statue from marble.
profile.exampleCn: 艺术家用大理石雕刻了一座美丽的雕像。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指停止运营或关闭，常用于企业、机器或系统。
profile.definition: Third person singular of shut down; to close or stop operating.
profile.example: The factory shuts down for maintenance every summer.
profile.exampleCn: 工厂每年夏天停工维修。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指用机枪或火炮从低空对地面目标进行攻击。
profile.definition: To attack (ground targets) with machine-gun fire or cannon fire from low-flying aircraft.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: An act of strafing.
otherMeanings.example: The strafe lasted for several minutes.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 扫射持续了几分钟。

profile.example: The fighter jets strafed the enemy convoy.
profile.exampleCn: 战斗机扫射了敌人的车队。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指政府允许纳税人从其应缴税款中扣除的金额，以鼓励某些行为或减轻负担。
profile.definition: An amount of money that a taxpayer can subtract from the tax they owe to the government.
profile.example: The government introduced a new tax credit for families with children.
profile.exampleCn: 政府为有孩子的家庭推出了一项新的税收抵免。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指经常去剧院观看演出的人。
profile.definition: People who regularly attend theatrical performances.
profile.example: Theatre-goers in London enjoy a wide variety of shows.
profile.exampleCn: 伦敦的戏迷们喜欢各种各样的演出。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指衣服等紧贴身体的，通常强调合身或紧绷。
profile.definition: clothes that are tight-fitting fit very closely to the body
profile.example: She wore a tight-fitting dress to the party.
profile.exampleCn: 她穿了一条紧身连衣裙去参加聚会。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 由工人组成的组织，旨在维护会员的工作条件、工资和权益。
profile.definition: an organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests
profile.example: The trade union negotiated a pay rise for its members.
profile.exampleCn: 工会为其成员谈判加薪。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指一个人或家庭每周获得的工资或收入总额。
profile.definition: the amount of money earned in a week
profile.example: His weekly earnings are enough to support his family.
profile.exampleCn: 他的每周收入足以养家糊口。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指已经做好充分准备，能够应对即将发生的事情。
profile.definition: having made all the necessary preparations
profile.example: She was well-prepared for the job interview.
profile.exampleCn: 她为求职面试做好了充分准备。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指行政管理或行政人员，常用于非正式场合。
profile.definition: the activity or process of organizing and managing a business or organization; also short for administrator

otherMeanings.definitionEn: a person who manages a website, forum, or social media account
otherMeanings.example: The admin of the group deleted the spam post.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 群组管理员删除了垃圾帖子。

profile.example: She works in admin at a local hospital.
profile.exampleCn: 她在当地一家医院做行政工作。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指获准进入某个地方或机构的权利或行为。
profile.definition: the right or permission to enter a place
profile.example: No admittance without a valid ID.
profile.exampleCn: 无有效身份证件不得入内。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指两个或多个事物在特征或外观上相似。
profile.definition: similar to each other

otherMeanings.definitionEn: in the same way or manner
otherMeanings.example: The rules apply to all members alike.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这些规则同样适用于所有成员。

profile.example: The two sisters look very alike.
profile.exampleCn: 这对姐妹长得很像。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 以动物为主题或装饰的，常用于描述活动、派对、装饰等。
profile.definition: Having animals as the main subject or decoration.
profile.example: The children's birthday party had an animal-themed decoration with balloons shaped like lions and tigers.
profile.exampleCn: 孩子们的生日派对采用了动物主题装饰，有狮子和大象形状的气球。

profile.meaning: 可学徒制的；适合当学徒的
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指某个职业或技能可以通过学徒制来学习，或者某人适合接受学徒培训。
profile.definition: Capable of being learned through an apprenticeship; suitable for an apprentice.
profile.example: Many trades such as plumbing and carpentry are apprenticeable, allowing young people to earn while they learn.
profile.exampleCn: 许多行业如管道工和木工都可以通过学徒制学习，让年轻人边赚钱边学习。

profile.meaning: 有风险的；处于危险中的
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指某人或某群体容易受到伤害、失败或陷入困境，常用于描述学生、人群或物种。
profile.definition: In danger of being harmed, failing, or experiencing negative outcomes.
profile.example: The government has introduced new programs to support at-risk youth in urban areas.
profile.exampleCn: 政府推出了新项目来支持城市地区的有风险青年。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指某人或某作品在竞赛或评选中获得过奖项，常用于描述电影、书籍、产品等。
profile.definition: Having won an award or awards.
profile.example: The award-winning film attracted a large audience at the international festival.
profile.exampleCn: 这部获奖影片在国际电影节上吸引了大量观众。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指衣物等因过大而不贴身，显得松垮。
profile.definition: (of clothes) hanging loosely because of being too big.
profile.example: He wore baggy jeans and a loose T-shirt to the casual party.
profile.exampleCn: 他穿着宽松的牛仔裤和一件宽松的T恤去参加休闲派对。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种细长的棍子，用于乐队指挥或接力赛跑中传递。
profile.definition: A thin stick used by a conductor to direct an orchestra, or a stick passed in a relay race.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A short heavy stick carried by police officers as a weapon.
otherMeanings.example: The police officer used his baton to control the crowd.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 警察用警棍控制人群。

profile.example: The conductor raised his baton and the orchestra began to play.
profile.exampleCn: 指挥家举起指挥棒，管弦乐队开始演奏。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 用来吓走鸟类的装置或人，常用于农田或果园。
profile.definition: Devices or people used to scare birds away from crops or areas.
profile.example: Farmers often use bird-scarers to protect their crops from being eaten by birds.
profile.exampleCn: 农民经常使用驱鸟器来保护庄稼不被鸟类吃掉。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 存放船只的建筑物，通常位于水边。
profile.definition: A building for storing boats, usually near water.
profile.example: They kept their rowing boat in a small boathouse by the lake.
profile.exampleCn: 他们把划艇放在湖边的一个小船库里。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指服务、场地或活动可以提前预订。
profile.definition: Able to be reserved or booked in advance.
profile.example: The conference room is bookable for meetings during business hours.
profile.exampleCn: 会议室在办公时间可以预订用于会议。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指物体撞击表面后向上弹回的动作，常用于描述球类或其他弹性物体的运动。
profile.definition: To move upward or away from a surface after hitting it.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: An act of bouncing or the ability to bounce.
otherMeanings.example: The ball has a good bounce.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这个球弹跳力很好。

profile.example: The children watched the ball bounces down the stairs.
profile.exampleCn: 孩子们看着球蹦蹦跳跳地滚下楼梯。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指表达或持续时间短而精炼，常用于形容言语或文章简明扼要。
profile.definition: The quality of being brief or concise in speech or writing.
profile.example: The brevity of the speech made it more impactful.
profile.exampleCn: 演讲的简洁使其更具影响力。

phraseCollocations.phrase: brevity is the soul of wit
phraseCollocations.chinese: 言简意赅是智慧的灵魂

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容物体体积大、占空间，且通常难以搬运或处理。
profile.definition: Large and heavy; difficult to move or carry.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Having a large and heavy body.
otherMeanings.example: He was a bulky man, taking up two seats on the bus.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他是个大块头，在公交车上占了两个座位。

profile.example: The bulky furniture was difficult to move through the narrow doorway.
profile.exampleCn: 这件笨重的家具很难通过狭窄的门口。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 描述物体因燃烧而受损或变黑的状态，也可指食物煮过头。
profile.definition: Damaged or blackened by fire or heat.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Past tense and past participle of burn.
otherMeanings.example: She burnt the toast.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她把面包烤焦了。

profile.example: The burnt smell from the kitchen alerted us to the fire.
profile.exampleCn: 厨房传来的烧焦味提醒我们着火了。

profile.meaning: 灌木食物；澳洲土著传统食物
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指澳大利亚原住民使用的本土植物和动物作为食物，通常来自野外。
profile.definition: Native Australian plants and animals used as food by Indigenous Australians.
profile.example: Bushfoods like wattleseed are becoming popular in modern cuisine.
profile.exampleCn: 像金合欢籽这样的灌木食物在现代烹饪中越来越受欢迎。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种无色无味的有毒气体，化学式CO，由碳不完全燃烧产生。
profile.definition: A poisonous gas, CO, produced by incomplete combustion of carbon.
profile.example: Carbon monoxide detectors are essential in every home.
profile.exampleCn: 每个家庭都必须安装一氧化碳探测器。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种厚而硬的纸材料，常用于制作盒子、包装材料等。
profile.definition: A stiff, thick paper material used for making boxes and packaging.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Made of cardboard.
otherMeanings.example: They lived in a cardboard box.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他们住在一个纸板箱里。

profile.example: We recycled the cardboard boxes after moving.
profile.exampleCn: 搬家后我们回收了纸板箱。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种针织上衣，前面有开口，通常用纽扣或拉链扣合，可套在其他衣服外面。
profile.definition: A knitted garment with an open front, typically fastened with buttons or a zip, worn over other clothes.
profile.example: She wore a grey cardigan over her shirt to stay warm in the office.
profile.exampleCn: 她在衬衫外面穿了一件灰色开襟羊毛衫，以便在办公室里保暖。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 描述某事物（如活动、机会）对提升职业发展有益，能帮助个人在职业生涯中取得进步。
profile.definition: Describing something that helps to advance one's professional development or career prospects.
profile.example: Taking an online course in project management is a career-building move for many professionals.
profile.exampleCn: 参加项目管理在线课程对许多专业人士来说是促进职业发展的一步。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指包裹或容纳某物的外层，如香肠的肠衣、电缆的外皮或机器的外壳。
profile.definition: The outer covering or container for something, such as the skin of a sausage, the protective covering of a cable, or the housing of a machine.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: The frame or surrounding structure of a window, door, etc.
otherMeanings.example: The casings around the windows were painted white.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 窗户周围的框架被漆成了白色。

profile.example: The sausages were made with natural casings from sheep intestines.
profile.exampleCn: 这些香肠是用羊肠制成的天然肠衣制作的。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 长度单位，等于一米的百分之一。
profile.definition: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter.
profile.example: The table is 120 centimetres long.
profile.exampleCn: 这张桌子长120厘米。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 英格兰西北部的一个郡，也用于指代柴郡奶酪。
profile.definition: A county in northwest England, also used to refer to Cheshire cheese.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A type of cheese originally made in Cheshire, England.
otherMeanings.example: Cheshire is a crumbly cheese with a salty taste.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 柴郡奶酪是一种易碎的奶酪，带有咸味。

profile.example: The village is located in the heart of Cheshire.
profile.exampleCn: 这个村庄位于柴郡的中心地带。

collocations.chinese: 柴郡猫（《爱丽丝梦游仙境》中的角色）

profile.meaningDetailZh: 描述水面因风浪而起伏不平，或描述文章、讲话等不流畅、断断续续。
profile.definition: Describing water that is rough with small waves, or speech/writing that is not smooth and continuous.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Not smooth or flowing; jerky or disjointed.
otherMeanings.example: The essay was choppy because of the many short sentences.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这篇文章因为很多短句而显得不连贯。

profile.example: The sea was choppy, making the boat ride uncomfortable.
profile.exampleCn: 海面波涛汹涌，使得乘船旅行很不舒服。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 与合唱团或唱诗班有关的，或由合唱团演唱的。
profile.definition: Relating to a choir or chorus, or sung by a choir.
profile.example: The choral performance at the concert was breathtaking.
profile.exampleCn: 音乐会上的合唱表演令人叹为观止。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 由成员共同拥有和经营的合作社，或指合作社经营的商店。
profile.definition: A cooperative organization or a shop run by a cooperative, where members share ownership and profits.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A cooperative education program, often combining study with work experience.
otherMeanings.example: She is doing a co-op at a tech company this semester.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这学期她在一家科技公司参加合作教育项目。

profile.example: The local co-op sells organic vegetables grown by its members.
profile.exampleCn: 当地的合作社出售其成员种植的有机蔬菜。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 由计算机控制或操作的，通常指自动化或数字化系统。
profile.definition: controlled or operated by computers, often implying automation or digital technology.
profile.example: The factory has become fully computer-driven, reducing the need for manual labor.
profile.exampleCn: 这家工厂已完全实现计算机驱动，减少了对人工劳动的需求。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 参加音乐会的人，通常指观众或听众。
profile.definition: people who attend concerts, typically as audience members.
profile.example: Thousands of concert-goers gathered in the park for the free music festival.
profile.exampleCn: 成千上万的音乐会观众聚集在公园里参加免费音乐节。

phraseCollocations.chinese: 成群结队的音乐会观众

profile.meaningDetailZh: 设备或系统之间连接和通信的能力，常指网络连接。
profile.definition: the ability of devices or systems to connect and communicate, often referring to network access.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: the state of being connected, especially in terms of transportation or communication networks.
otherMeanings.example: The new bridge improved connectivity between the two cities.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 新桥改善了两座城市之间的连通性。

profile.example: The hotel offers free Wi-Fi, ensuring good connectivity for business travelers.
profile.exampleCn: 这家酒店提供免费Wi-Fi，确保商务旅客有良好的网络连接。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 能够被联系到的，通常指通过电话、电子邮件等方式。
profile.definition: able to be contacted, typically by phone, email, or other means.
profile.example: Please ensure you are contactable during the interview process.
profile.exampleCn: 请确保在面试过程中可以联系到您。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 与英国康沃尔郡相关的，或指康沃尔人、康沃尔语。
profile.definition: relating to Cornwall, its people, or the Cornish language.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: the people of Cornwall collectively.
otherMeanings.example: The Cornish have a rich cultural heritage.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 康沃尔人拥有丰富的文化遗产。

otherMeanings.definitionEn: the Celtic language historically spoken in Cornwall.
otherMeanings.example: She is learning Cornish to connect with her roots.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她正在学习康沃尔语以联系自己的根源。

profile.example: The Cornish coastline attracts many tourists every year.
profile.exampleCn: 康沃尔海岸线每年吸引许多游客。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 从事手工艺制作的人，如制作陶器、编织等。
profile.definition: people who make things by hand, such as pottery, weaving, or other crafts.
profile.example: Local crafters sell their handmade goods at the weekend market.
profile.exampleCn: 当地手工艺人在周末市场上出售他们的手工制品。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 非常清晰透明，常形容水、玻璃等；也比喻意思明确。
profile.definition: extremely clear and transparent, often describing water or glass; also used figuratively to mean easy to understand.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: very easy to understand; unambiguous.
otherMeanings.example: The instructions were crystal-clear, so we had no trouble assembling the furniture.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 说明非常清楚，所以我们组装家具没有困难。

profile.example: The lake was crystal-clear, allowing us to see the fish swimming below.
profile.exampleCn: 湖水清澈见底，让我们能看到下面游动的鱼。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 专为自行车设计的道路或路径，通常与机动车道分开。
profile.definition: roads or paths designed specifically for bicycles, often separated from motor traffic.
profile.example: The city has invested in new cycleways to encourage more people to bike to work.
profile.exampleCn: 该市投资建设了新的自行车道，以鼓励更多人骑自行车上班。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 有勇气做某事；挑战或激将某人做某事。
profile.definition: had the courage to do something; challenged someone to do something risky.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: to challenge someone to do something dangerous or difficult.
otherMeanings.example: She dared him to jump off the diving board.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她激将他从跳板上跳下去。

profile.example: He dared to speak out against the unfair policy.
profile.exampleCn: 他敢于公开反对不公平的政策。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 味道很好的煎饼，通常作为早餐或甜点。
profile.definition: pancakes that taste very good, often served for breakfast or dessert.
profile.example: The café is known for its delicious pancakes topped with fresh berries.
profile.exampleCn: 这家咖啡馆以新鲜浆果装饰的美味煎饼而闻名。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指牙科医学专业，包括对牙齿、牙龈和口腔疾病的预防、诊断和治疗。
profile.definition: The profession or science of treating diseases and conditions of the teeth and gums.
profile.example: She decided to study dentistry at university because she wanted to help people with dental problems.
profile.exampleCn: 她决定在大学学习牙科，因为她想帮助有牙齿问题的人。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指频繁排出稀便或水样便的症状，通常由感染或食物中毒引起。
profile.definition: A condition in which feces are discharged from the bowels frequently and in a liquid form.
profile.example: The doctor advised the patient to drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration from diarrhoea.
profile.exampleCn: 医生建议病人多喝水以防腹泻导致脱水。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 用于否定过去时态的动词，表示“没有做某事”。
profile.definition: Short form of 'did not', used to form negative statements in the past tense.
profile.example: I didnt go to the party last night because I was too tired.
profile.exampleCn: 我昨晚没去参加聚会，因为我太累了。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指吃饭的行为或活动，常用于描述与用餐相关的场合或设施。
profile.definition: The activity of eating a meal, especially in a formal or social context.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Relating to the act of eating a meal.
otherMeanings.example: The hotel has a beautiful dining room overlooking the sea.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这家酒店有一个可以俯瞰大海的漂亮餐厅。

profile.example: The hotel offers fine dining with a variety of international dishes.
profile.exampleCn: 这家酒店提供精美的餐饮，有多种国际菜肴。

profile.meaning: 董事会；理事会；主管部门
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指负责管理或监督某个组织或政府部门的委员会或机构。
profile.definition: A board of directors or a group of people who manage an organization or a government department.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: The position or office of a director.
otherMeanings.example: He was appointed to the directorate of the company last year.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他去年被任命为公司董事。

profile.example: The directorate of the hospital decided to implement new health policies.
profile.exampleCn: 医院董事会决定实施新的卫生政策。

profile.meaning: 缺乏组织的；杂乱无章的
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指没有良好组织或计划，导致混乱或效率低下。
profile.definition: Not properly planned or organized; messy and chaotic.
profile.example: The disorganised meeting wasted everyone's time because there was no clear agenda.
profile.exampleCn: 这次会议组织混乱，因为没有明确的议程，浪费了大家的时间。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指双方或多方之间的不同意见或争执，通常涉及利益或权利。
profile.definition: A disagreement or argument between people or groups.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To question the truth or validity of something.
otherMeanings.example: The lawyer disputed the witness's testimony.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 律师对证人的证词提出质疑。

profile.example: The two countries are in a dispute over fishing rights in the region.
profile.exampleCn: 两国在该地区的捕鱼权问题上存在争端。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指机器或系统不工作的时间，或指人放松休息的时间。
profile.definition: Time when a machine or system is not working, or time when a person can relax.
profile.example: The website experienced unexpected downtime during the sale, causing frustration for customers.
profile.exampleCn: 网站在大促期间意外停机，导致顾客不满。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指城市的主要商业区或中心区域，通常集中了商店、办公楼和娱乐场所。
profile.definition: The central business district of a city, typically with shops, offices, and entertainment venues.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Located in or relating to the central business district.
otherMeanings.example: They live in a downtown apartment.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他们住在市中心的一套公寓里。

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To or in the central business district.
otherMeanings.example: We drove downtown for the meeting.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 我们开车去市中心开会。

profile.example: The new library is located downtown, making it accessible to many residents.
profile.exampleCn: 新图书馆位于市中心，方便许多居民使用。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种用于收紧或系紧衣物、袋子等物品的绳子或细带。
profile.definition: A cord or string that is pulled to tighten or close something, such as clothing or a bag.
profile.example: The jacket has a drawstring at the waist to adjust the fit.
profile.exampleCn: 这件夹克腰部有拉绳，可以调节松紧。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 动词dry的第三人称单数形式，表示使某物变干或变得干燥。
profile.definition: Third person singular of 'dry', meaning to become dry or to make something dry.
profile.example: The paint dries quickly in the sun.
profile.exampleCn: 油漆在阳光下干得很快。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指具有两种不同功能或用途的。
profile.definition: Having two different functions or uses.
profile.example: This dual-purpose sofa can be used as a bed at night.
profile.exampleCn: 这张双用途沙发晚上可以当床用。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 从生态或环境角度看待问题的观点或立场。
profile.definition: A viewpoint that considers environmental or ecological aspects.
profile.example: From an eco-perspective, using public transport is more sustainable.
profile.exampleCn: 从生态视角来看，使用公共交通更可持续。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 物体在外力作用下发生形变，去除外力后恢复原状的能力；也指灵活性。
profile.definition: The ability of an object to return to its original shape after being stretched or compressed; also flexibility.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: The ability to adapt to change or new conditions.
otherMeanings.example: The elasticity of the schedule allowed us to add extra meetings.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 日程的灵活性使我们能够增加额外的会议。

profile.example: The elasticity of the rubber band makes it useful for various tasks.
profile.exampleCn: 橡皮筋的弹性使其适用于各种任务。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 动词empty的现在分词，表示使容器等变空或倒空。
profile.definition: Present participle of 'empty', meaning to remove the contents of something.
profile.example: She is emptying the trash bin in the kitchen.
profile.exampleCn: 她正在清空厨房的垃圾桶。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指一天工作或活动结束的时候，常用于总结或反思。
profile.definition: The time at the end of a day, often used to refer to a final assessment or conclusion.
profile.example: At the end of the day, we need to make a decision.
profile.exampleCn: 归根结底，我们需要做出决定。

collocations.phrase: at the end of the day
by the end of the day

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指适合初学者或刚开始工作的人的，通常指职位或产品。
profile.definition: Suitable for beginners or people starting a career; often referring to jobs or products.
profile.example: She applied for an entry-level position at the company.
profile.exampleCn: 她申请了公司的一个入门级职位。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指公正、合理的，尤其在分配或待遇方面。
profile.definition: Fair and reasonable, especially in terms of distribution or treatment.
profile.example: The government aims to create an equitable distribution of resources.
profile.exampleCn: 政府旨在实现资源的公平分配。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 描述两个人或群体直接相遇、相互面对的情形，通常指亲自交流而非通过媒介。
profile.definition: Involving direct contact between people; in person.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: In direct personal contact; in person.
otherMeanings.example: We discussed the issue face-to-face.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 我们面对面地讨论了这个问题。

profile.example: Many employees prefer face-to-face meetings for important discussions.
profile.exampleCn: 许多员工更喜欢面对面会议来进行重要讨论。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指通过接触或学习使自己对某事物变得熟悉的过程。
profile.definition: The process of becoming familiar with something.
profile.example: The training program includes a familiarisation with the company's safety procedures.
profile.exampleCn: 培训项目包括熟悉公司的安全程序。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 描述某事物（如场所、政策、活动）对家庭友好，适合有孩子的家庭使用或参与。
profile.definition: Suitable for families, especially those with children.
profile.example: The hotel is family-friendly, offering a kids' club and babysitting services.
profile.exampleCn: 这家酒店适合家庭，提供儿童俱乐部和保姆服务。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指与某人共享某种身份或活动的人，如同事、同学或同伴。
profile.definition: A person who shares a particular activity or situation with another; a companion or colleague.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Belonging to the same group or sharing a common characteristic.
otherMeanings.example: He is a fellow student of mine.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他是我的同学。

profile.example: My fellow workers and I organized a farewell party for our manager.
profile.exampleCn: 我和同事们为经理组织了一场欢送会。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容物体容易损坏或缺乏坚固性，也可指借口或论据等不充分。
profile.definition: Easily damaged or broken; weak and not solid.

otherMeanings.meaningZh: 站不住脚的（借口、论据等）
otherMeanings.definitionEn: (of an excuse, argument, etc.) weak and not convincing.
otherMeanings.example: He gave a flimsy excuse for being late.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他为迟到找了一个站不住脚的借口。

profile.example: The flimsy cardboard box collapsed under the weight of the books.
profile.exampleCn: 这个脆弱的纸板箱在书的重量下塌了。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指为防御而建造的军事建筑或设防地点。
profile.definition: A fortified building or military stronghold.
profile.example: The old fort on the hill attracts many tourists every year.
profile.exampleCn: 山上的古老堡垒每年吸引许多游客。

profile.meaning: 磨损的， fraying 边缘的
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指布料、绳索等因磨损而边缘散开或变得粗糙的状态。
profile.definition: becoming worn or thin at the edges, with threads coming loose.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: the loose threads or worn part of a fabric or rope.
otherMeanings.example: The fraying on the cuffs of his shirt was noticeable.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他衬衫袖口的磨损处很明显。

profile.example: The fraying edges of the old carpet made it unsafe to walk on.
profile.exampleCn: 旧地毯磨损的边缘使其行走不安全。

phraseCollocations.chinese: 在接缝处磨损；濒临崩溃

profile.meaning: 未来主义的，极其先进的
profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容设计、技术或风格非常先进，看起来属于未来时代。
profile.definition: having or involving very modern technology or design, seemingly belonging to the future.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: relating to the artistic movement of Futurism.
otherMeanings.example: The gallery exhibited futuristic paintings from the early 20th century.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 画廊展出了20世纪初的未来派绘画。

profile.example: The city's futuristic architecture attracts many tourists every year.
profile.exampleCn: 这座城市未来主义的建筑每年吸引许多游客。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指经常玩电子游戏或电脑游戏的人。
profile.definition: people who play video games or computer games regularly.
profile.example: Many gamers spend hours online competing with players from around the world.
profile.exampleCn: 许多游戏玩家花数小时在线与世界各地的玩家竞争。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种非洲大型哺乳动物，脖子很长，身上有斑点。
profile.definition: large African mammals with very long necks and spotted coats.
profile.example: Giraffes use their long necks to reach leaves high up in trees.
profile.exampleCn: 长颈鹿用它们的长脖子够到树上的高叶子。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容物体或空间大小令人满意，足够大。
profile.definition: fairly large; of a satisfactory size.
profile.example: They live in a good-sized house with a large garden.
profile.exampleCn: 他们住在一栋相当大的房子里，带一个大花园。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种大型类人猿，生活在非洲，体型强壮，以植物为食。
profile.definition: large apes native to Africa, known for their strength and intelligence.
profile.example: Gorillas are endangered due to habitat loss and poaching.
profile.exampleCn: 由于栖息地丧失和偷猎，大猩猩濒临灭绝。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种粘稠的油性物质，常用于润滑机械或烹饪。
profile.definition: a thick oily substance used for lubrication or in cooking.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: to apply grease to something, especially to lubricate or prepare for cooking.
otherMeanings.example: Grease the baking pan before pouring in the batter.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 在倒入面糊之前，给烤盘涂上油脂。

profile.example: The mechanic wiped the grease off his hands before checking the engine.
profile.exampleCn: 机械师在检查发动机前擦掉手上的油脂。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指细小的沙石颗粒，也比喻坚韧不拔的勇气和决心。
profile.definition: small loose particles of sand or stone; also, courage and determination.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: to spread grit on a surface, especially a road or path.
otherMeanings.example: They gritted the icy road to make it safer for drivers.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他们在结冰的路上撒沙砾，使司机更安全。

profile.example: She showed real grit in overcoming the challenges of her new job.
profile.exampleCn: 她在克服新工作的挑战中表现出了真正的毅力。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种用绳索或布料制成的床，两端悬挂在支架或树上，可摇摆。
profile.definition: a bed made of canvas or rope netting, suspended between two points.
profile.example: We hung a hammock between two trees in the garden for afternoon naps.
profile.exampleCn: 我们在花园的两棵树之间挂了一张吊床，供午后小睡。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容材料或物品能承受大量使用而不易损坏。
profile.definition: able to withstand much wear and tear; durable.
profile.example: These boots are hard-wearing and perfect for hiking.
profile.exampleCn: 这双靴子很耐磨，非常适合徒步旅行。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种戴在头上的照明设备，通常用于户外活动，如露营、徒步或夜间工作。
profile.definition: A portable light attached to a headband or helmet, used for hands-free illumination.
profile.example: When we went camping, I used a head-torch to find my way to the tent at night.
profile.exampleCn: 我们去露营时，晚上我用头灯找到去帐篷的路。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指图像、视频或音频具有高分辨率或高清晰度，细节丰富。
profile.definition: Having a high resolution; producing or displaying images with fine detail.
profile.example: The new camera takes hi-res photos that are perfect for printing large posters.
profile.exampleCn: 新相机拍摄的高分辨率照片非常适合打印大幅海报。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种女性穿的及大腿或及膝的长袜，通常用弹性带或吊带固定，不需要腰带。
profile.definition: Women's stockings that are held up by elastic tops or suspenders, not requiring a garter belt.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Delays or obstructions, especially in traffic or progress.
otherMeanings.example: There were several hold-ups on the motorway due to the accident.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 由于事故，高速公路上有几处延误。

profile.example: She wore a pair of black hold-ups with her evening dress.
profile.exampleCn: 她穿着黑色长筒袜配晚礼服。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 描述与假期、旅行或度假相关的事物或活动。
profile.definition: Connected with or relating to holidays or vacations.
profile.example: The store offers a wide range of holiday-related products, from decorations to travel guides.
profile.exampleCn: 这家商店提供各种与假期相关的产品，从装饰品到旅行指南。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 使用吸尘器清洁地面或地毯。
profile.definition: Past tense of 'hoover', meaning to clean with a vacuum cleaner.
profile.example: I hoovered the living room before the guests arrived.
profile.exampleCn: 客人到达之前，我用吸尘器打扫了客厅。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容人或动物背部有隆起的曲线，或指有拱形结构的物体。
profile.definition: Having a hump on the back; also used to describe a bridge with a steep arch.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Describing a bridge that rises in the middle like a hump.
otherMeanings.example: The hump-backed bridge over the canal is very old.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 运河上的那座拱桥非常古老。

profile.example: The hump-backed camel is well adapted to desert life.
profile.exampleCn: 驼背的骆驼非常适应沙漠生活。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 为身体补充水分，或使物质与水结合。
profile.definition: To cause to absorb water; to supply with water to maintain proper fluid balance.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A chemical compound that contains water molecules.
otherMeanings.example: The mineral is a hydrate of calcium sulfate.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这种矿物是硫酸钙的水合物。

profile.example: It's important to hydrate regularly during exercise to avoid dehydration.
profile.exampleCn: 运动期间定期补水以避免脱水非常重要。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指发生在移动应用程序内部的功能、购买或内容。
profile.definition: Occurring or available within a mobile application.
profile.example: The game offers in-app purchases to unlock new levels.
profile.exampleCn: 这款游戏提供应用内购买以解锁新关卡。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指在飞机飞行过程中发生或提供的服务、娱乐等。
profile.definition: Occurring or provided during an aircraft flight.
profile.example: The airline offers a wide selection of in-flight movies.
profile.exampleCn: 这家航空公司提供丰富的飞行中电影选择。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指使病毒、酶等失去活性，常用于疫苗制备或生物实验。
profile.definition: Made inactive; especially referring to a virus or enzyme that has been treated to lose its ability to cause infection or reaction.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Past tense of 'inactivate', meaning to make something inactive.
otherMeanings.example: The heat inactivated the enzyme in the sample.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 加热使样品中的酶失活。

profile.example: The vaccine contains an inactivated virus that cannot cause disease.
profile.exampleCn: 该疫苗含有无法引起疾病的灭活病毒。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 缩写形式，常用于书面语或列表中，表示“包括”或“包含”。
profile.definition: Abbreviation for 'including' or 'inclusive'.
profile.example: Price: $50, incl. tax.
profile.exampleCn: 价格：50美元，含税。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容人对他人（尤其是孩子）过分宽容，允许他们为所欲为，或对自己欲望的放纵。
profile.definition: Having or showing a tendency to be too generous or lenient, especially in allowing someone to have or do what they want.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Allowing oneself to enjoy pleasures or desires without restraint.
otherMeanings.example: She had an indulgent weekend of shopping and spa treatments.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她度过了一个放纵的周末，购物和做水疗。

profile.example: Her indulgent parents let her stay up as late as she wanted.
profile.exampleCn: 她纵容的父母让她想多晚睡就多晚睡。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 以良好的判断力或谨慎的方式行事。
profile.definition: In a way that shows good judgment or sense.
profile.example: She judiciously invested her savings in a diversified portfolio.
profile.exampleCn: 她明智地将积蓄投资于多元化的投资组合。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指年龄较小或职位、级别较低的人。
profile.definition: Younger in age or lower in rank or position.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A person who is younger or of lower rank.
otherMeanings.example: He is my junior by two years.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他比我小两岁。

otherMeanings.meaningZh: （美国四年制大学或中学的）三年级学生
otherMeanings.definitionEn: A student in the third year of a four-year college or high school.
otherMeanings.example: She is a junior at the university.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她是大学三年级学生。

profile.example: He is a junior member of the team.
profile.exampleCn: 他是团队中的初级成员。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种轻便的小船，通常由一人用双叶桨划动。
profile.definition: A light, narrow boat for one person, propelled by a double-bladed paddle.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To travel or race in a kayak.
otherMeanings.example: We kayaked down the river.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 我们划皮划艇顺流而下。

profile.example: They went kayaking in the fjord.
profile.exampleCn: 他们在峡湾里划皮划艇。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 用于描述设备或功能，能够保持食物或饮料的温度。
profile.definition: Describing a function or device that maintains the temperature of food or drink.
profile.example: The rice cooker has a keep-warm setting.
profile.exampleCn: 电饭煲有保温功能。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 质量单位，等于1000克。这是英式拼写，美式拼写为kilogram。
profile.definition: A unit of mass equal to 1,000 grams. British spelling of 'kilogram'.
profile.example: The parcel weighs two kilogrammes.
profile.exampleCn: 这个包裹重两公斤。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 中世纪欧洲受过正式训练的骑兵，或现代英国授予的荣誉头衔。
profile.definition: A man given a rank of honor by a king or queen, or a medieval soldier on horseback.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To give someone the rank of knight.
otherMeanings.example: He was knighted by the Queen for his services.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他因功勋被女王封为爵士。

profile.example: The knight rode into battle.
profile.exampleCn: 骑士骑马进入战斗。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 描述衣物等已经过清洗。
profile.definition: Having been washed or cleaned, especially clothes.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Past tense of 'launder', meaning to wash clothes or to conceal the origins of money.
otherMeanings.example: She laundered the clothes in the machine.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她用洗衣机洗了衣服。

profile.example: The laundered shirts were neatly folded.
profile.exampleCn: 洗过的衬衫叠得整整齐齐。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指火箭、航天器或飞机从地面升空的动作或时刻。
profile.definition: The action or moment of a spacecraft, rocket, or aircraft rising from the ground into the air.
profile.example: The rocket's lift-off was delayed due to bad weather.
profile.exampleCn: 由于天气恶劣，火箭的发射被推迟了。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指一组为特定目的（如演出、比赛或活动）而安排的人或事物，或指排队等候的一群人。
profile.definition: A group of people or things arranged for a particular purpose, such as a performance, game, or event; or a queue of people.

otherMeanings.meaningZh: （警方安排的）一排嫌疑人供辨认
otherMeanings.definitionEn: A row of people arranged by police for identification by a witness.
otherMeanings.example: The witness picked the suspect out of a line-up.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 目击者从一排嫌疑人中指认出了嫌疑人。

profile.example: The band's line-up for the concert includes several famous musicians.
profile.exampleCn: 这场音乐会的乐队阵容包括几位著名音乐家。

profile.meaning: 住在家里的；住雇主家的
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指（雇员，如保姆或管家）住在雇主家中，或指（伴侣）同居的。
profile.definition: Living in the place where one works (e.g., a domestic employee) or living with a partner in the same residence.
profile.example: They hired a live-in nanny to take care of the children.
profile.exampleCn: 他们雇了一位住家保姆来照顾孩子。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指夏威夷果树的坚果，可食用，常用于烘焙或直接食用。
profile.definition: The edible nuts of the macadamia tree, often eaten as a snack or used in cooking.
profile.example: Macadamias are a popular ingredient in cookies and chocolates.
profile.exampleCn: 夏威夷果是饼干和巧克力中常用的配料。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容具有传统上被认为属于男性的品质，如勇敢、强壮或果断。
profile.definition: Having qualities traditionally associated with men, such as bravery, strength, or decisiveness.
profile.example: He has a manly voice and a confident manner.
profile.exampleCn: 他声音浑厚，举止自信。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指一种柔软、有弹性的糖果，通常为白色，由糖、明胶等制成，常用于热饮或烧烤。
profile.definition: Soft, chewy confections made from sugar, gelatin, etc., often white and used in hot drinks or roasted over a fire.
profile.example: We roasted marshmallows over the campfire.
profile.exampleCn: 我们在篝火上烤棉花糖。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指在下午举行的戏剧、电影或音乐会等演出。
profile.definition: Performances, such as plays, films, or concerts, held in the afternoon.
profile.example: We went to a matinee of the new musical on Saturday afternoon.
profile.exampleCn: 周六下午我们去看了新音乐剧的日场。

phraseCollocations.chinese: 日场偶像（受欢迎的男演员）

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指修理或缝补衣物等物品的行为或过程。
profile.definition: The act or process of repairing or sewing something, especially clothes.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To repair something that is broken or damaged.
otherMeanings.example: He mended the broken chair with glue.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 他用胶水修补了坏椅子。

profile.example: She spent the afternoon doing the mending.
profile.exampleCn: 她花了一下午的时间做缝补。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指为男性设计的服装，包括西装、衬衫、裤子等。
profile.definition: Clothing designed for men, such as suits, shirts, and trousers.
profile.example: The store has a wide selection of menswear, from casual to formal.
profile.exampleCn: 这家商店有各种男装，从休闲到正式都有。

profile.meaning: 下午三点左右；午后中段
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指下午的中间时段，大约在下午2点到4点之间。
profile.definition: The middle part of the afternoon, roughly between 2 and 4 p.m.
profile.example: The meeting is scheduled for mid-afternoon.
profile.exampleCn: 会议安排在下午三点左右。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 表示从星期一到星期五的五个工作日，常用于时间安排或营业时间。
profile.definition: Abbreviation for Monday to Friday, used to indicate the five working days of the week.
profile.example: The gym is open Mon-Fri from 6 am to 10 pm.
profile.exampleCn: 健身房周一至周五早上6点到晚上10点开放。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 表示每个星期一，常用于描述定期发生的事件或习惯。
profile.definition: On every Monday; used to describe something that happens regularly on Mondays.
profile.example: I have a yoga class on Mondays after work.
profile.exampleCn: 我每周一下班后有瑜伽课。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指月亮照射到地面的光，常用于描述夜晚的景色或氛围。
profile.definition: The light that comes from the moon at night.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: To have a second job, especially at night, in addition to one's main job.
otherMeanings.example: She moonlights as a waitress on weekends.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她周末兼职当服务员。

profile.example: The lake looked beautiful in the moonlight.
profile.exampleCn: 月光下，湖面看起来很美。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指使用机动车辆进行的竞技运动，如赛车、摩托车赛等。
profile.definition: The sport of racing motor vehicles, such as cars and motorcycles.
profile.example: Motorsport is a popular spectator sport in many countries.
profile.exampleCn: 赛车运动在许多国家是受欢迎的观赏性运动。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容食物或气味非常诱人，让人流口水。
profile.definition: Looking or smelling so good that you want to eat it immediately.
profile.example: The bakery displayed a mouth-watering array of cakes.
profile.exampleCn: 面包店展示了一系列令人垂涎的蛋糕。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种结合多种锻炼功能的健身器材，通常用于家庭或健身房。
profile.definition: A piece of exercise equipment that allows you to perform various exercises for different muscle groups.
profile.example: He bought a multi-gym to work out at home.
profile.exampleCn: 他买了一台多功能健身器在家锻炼。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 描述与音乐有关的事物、活动或职业。
profile.definition: Connected with music; having to do with music.
profile.example: She works in a music-related industry, producing albums.
profile.exampleCn: 她在音乐相关行业工作，制作专辑。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 一种非常深的蓝色，类似海军制服的颜色。
profile.definition: Very dark blue in color.
profile.example: She wore a navy-blue dress to the interview.
profile.exampleCn: 她穿了一条深蓝色的连衣裙去面试。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指几乎发生但最终避免的意外或碰撞，常指交通事故或危险情况。
profile.definition: A situation in which an accident or collision almost happens but is avoided.
profile.example: The pilot reported a near-miss with another aircraft.
profile.exampleCn: 飞行员报告了与另一架飞机险些相撞的事件。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容最近获得或发现的某种品质、兴趣或状态。
profile.definition: Recently discovered or acquired.
profile.example: She enjoyed her new-found freedom after moving out.
profile.exampleCn: 搬出去后，她享受到了新获得的自由。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指刚刚经过翻新、修复或重新装饰的，通常用于描述建筑物、房间或设施。
profile.definition: Recently renovated or restored to a good condition.
profile.example: The hotel offers newly-refurbished rooms with modern amenities.
profile.exampleCn: 这家酒店提供新装修的房间，配有现代化设施。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指用牙齿轻轻地、小口地咬食物或其他东西，通常指吃零食或小口品尝。
profile.definition: To take small bites of something, especially food.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A small bite or amount of food.
otherMeanings.example: She took a nibble of the cheese.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她咬了一小口奶酪。

profile.example: During the meeting, he nibbled on some biscuits.
profile.exampleCn: 会议期间，他小口地吃了一些饼干。

profile.meaning: 简朴的，不提供多余服务的
profile.meaningDetailZh: 指产品或服务只提供基本功能，没有不必要的装饰或额外服务，通常价格较低。
profile.definition: Providing only the basic features or services, without extras or luxuries.
profile.example: The no-frills airline offers cheap tickets but charges for baggage.
profile.exampleCn: 这家廉价航空公司提供便宜的机票，但行李要收费。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 形容人或方法注重实效，不浪费时间在无关紧要的事情上，态度严肃直接。
profile.definition: Practical and direct, without wasting time on unnecessary things.
profile.example: She is a no-nonsense manager who expects high standards.
profile.exampleCn: 她是一位务实的经理，期望高标准。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指未参加某个活动、会议或课程的行为或状态。
profile.definition: The fact of not being present at an event, meeting, or class.
profile.example: Non-attendance at the training session may result in a fine.
profile.exampleCn: 缺席培训课程可能会被罚款。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指不需要立即处理的情况或服务，通常用于医疗、交通等领域。
profile.definition: Not requiring immediate action or attention; not an emergency.
profile.example: For non-emergency medical issues, please visit your local clinic.
profile.exampleCn: 对于非紧急的医疗问题，请到当地诊所就诊。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指不属于政府或不由政府控制的组织，通常指非政府组织（NGO）。
profile.definition: Not belonging to or controlled by a government.
profile.example: Many non-governmental organizations provide aid in disaster areas.
profile.exampleCn: 许多非政府组织在灾区提供援助。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指材料表面没有小孔，液体或气体无法通过，常用于描述厨房台面、地板等。
profile.definition: Not having tiny holes, so liquids or gases cannot pass through.
profile.example: The kitchen counter is made of non-porous material, making it easy to clean.
profile.exampleCn: 厨房台面由无孔材料制成，易于清洁。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指组织或活动不以盈利为目的，通常用于慈善、教育等公益事业。
profile.definition: Not intended to make a profit, usually referring to organizations that use funds for charitable purposes.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: A non-profit organization.
otherMeanings.example: She works for a non-profit that helps homeless people.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 她在一家帮助无家可归者的非营利组织工作。

profile.example: The non-profit organization relies on donations to fund its projects.
profile.exampleCn: 这个非营利组织依靠捐款来资助其项目。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指在某个领域没有专门知识或技能的人。
profile.definition: A person who does not have specialized knowledge or training in a particular subject.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Not requiring or having specialized knowledge.
otherMeanings.example: The book is written for a non-specialist audience.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这本书是为非专业读者写的。

profile.example: The lecture was designed for non-specialists, so it was easy to follow.
profile.exampleCn: 这个讲座是为非专业人士设计的，所以很容易理解。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指表面经过特殊处理，食物不易粘附，常用于炊具。
profile.definition: Having a surface that prevents food from sticking during cooking.
profile.example: I prefer using a non-stick frying pan to cook eggs without adding too much oil.
profile.exampleCn: 我更喜欢用不粘锅煎鸡蛋，这样不用放太多油。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指设计用于在崎岖或未铺装路面上行驶的车辆，通常具有较高的底盘和四轮驱动。
profile.definition: Vehicles designed for driving on rough or unpaved surfaces.
profile.example: Many off-roaders are popular among adventure enthusiasts who enjoy exploring remote areas.
profile.exampleCn: 许多越野车深受喜欢探索偏远地区的冒险爱好者的欢迎。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指被认为预示未来事件（尤其是坏事）的现象或迹象。
profile.definition: An event or sign that is believed to predict the future, especially something bad.
profile.example: The sudden appearance of black clouds was considered an omen of the coming storm.
profile.exampleCn: 黑云的突然出现被认为是暴风雨来临的预兆。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指通过互联网连接或可访问的，常用于描述服务、活动或状态。
profile.definition: Connected to or available through the internet.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: In a way that is connected to the internet.
otherMeanings.example: You can apply for the course on-line.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 你可以在线申请这门课程。

profile.example: Many people now prefer on-line shopping because it is convenient and time-saving.
profile.exampleCn: 许多人现在更喜欢网上购物，因为它方便又省时。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指为某项目或活动投入的金钱总额。
profile.definition: An amount of money spent on something.
profile.example: The initial outlay for setting up a small business can be quite high.
profile.exampleCn: 创办小企业的初始支出可能相当高。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 强调完全或彻底，常用于否定或强调语气。
profile.definition: Completely or entirely.

otherMeanings.definitionEn: Complete and total.
otherMeanings.example: The proposal was an outright failure.
otherMeanings.exampleCn: 这个提议彻底失败了。

profile.example: She rejected the offer outright without considering the benefits.
profile.exampleCn: 她完全拒绝了那个提议，没有考虑好处。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指偶然听到别人的谈话，并非有意偷听。
profile.definition: Heard (something) by chance when it was not intended for you.
profile.example: I overheard a conversation about the upcoming job cuts while waiting in the queue.
profile.exampleCn: 我在排队时无意中听到一段关于即将裁员的谈话。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指比其他因素更重要或更具影响力。
profile.definition: More important than anything else; predominant.
profile.example: The overriding concern for the committee was the safety of the participants.
profile.exampleCn: 委员会最关心的是参与者的安全。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指在比赛中为他人设定速度的运动员的所有格形式，表示属于领跑者的。
profile.definition: Belonging to a pacer, a person who sets the pace in a race.
profile.example: The pacer's job is to maintain a steady speed for the runners.
profile.exampleCn: 领跑者的工作是为跑步者保持稳定的速度。

profile.meaningDetailZh: 指一种用于水上运动的长而宽的浮板，使用者站立并用桨划行。
